'''Bale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was native the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Bales was a member of a resistance cell that opposed the [[Cult of Veroleem]], a religious sect that ruled the planet, and the cultists eventually captured Bale and imprisoned him in a jail in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[New Promise]]. After spending some time in the institution, Bale encountered a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that had also been imprisoned there and he and the spacers co-operated to stage a jailbreak. Bale then led the spacers to a safe-house that the resistance maintained in New Promise.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">{{WizCite|story=The Finding of Lost Souls|book=The Unknown Regions}}</ref>
